mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM usage_event WHERE create_time >= CURDATE() UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM login_log WHERE success = 1 AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= CURDATE() ) t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'USER' AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM `user` WHERE role = 'USER' AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time)
SELECT module, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, COUNT(*) AS events FROM usage_event WHERE create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY module ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.create_time, MAX(a.day) AS last_active_day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.day >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) THEN a.day END) AS days7 FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, DATE(create_time) AS day FROM usage_event) a ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'USER' GROUP BY u.id, u.create_time

WITH cohorts AS ( SELECT id, DATE(create_time) AS cohort FROM `user` WHERE role = 'USER' AND create_time >= #{start} ), flags AS ( SELECT c.id, c.cohort, MAX(CASE WHEN DATE(a.create_time) = DATE_ADD(c.cohort, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1, MAX(CASE WHEN DATE(a.create_time) = DATE_ADD(c.cohort, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d7, MAX(CASE WHEN DATE(a.create_time) = DATE_ADD(c.cohort, INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d30 FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN usage_event a ON a.user_id = c.id AND a.create_time >= c.cohort AND a.create_time < DATE_ADD(c.cohort, INTERVAL 31 DAY) GROUP BY c.id, c.cohort ) SELECT cohort AS cohort_date, COUNT(*) AS size, SUM(d1) AS d1, SUM(d7) AS d7, SUM(d30) AS d30 FROM flags GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort DESC
mapper.sql: WITH activity AS ( SELECT user_id, DATE(create_time) AS day FROM usage_event ) SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.status, u.create_time, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `record` r WHERE r.user_id = u.id) AS record_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.day) FROM activity a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.day >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)) AS active_days_30 FROM `user` u

where.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(x.create_time)) FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)) >= 5

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(x.create_time)) FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)) < 5
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id)

mapper.select: ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.status, u.create_time, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(u.create_time)) AS register_days, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS account_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `record` x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS record_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS category_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS budget_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goal x WHERE x.user_id = u.id) AS goal_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.module = 'BRIEF') AS brief_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(x.create_time)) FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND x.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)) AS active_days_30, (SELECT x.module FROM usage_event x WHERE x.user_id = u.id ORDER BY x.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_module FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{id}
